rules.statement: A declared non-empty space the principal has no role in is Rejected(SPACE_NOT_MEMBER); it never falls back to the default space (C3).
properties: model:ScopeResolverPropertyTest#P11 a resolved scope only narrows

rules.statement: When the host has an app, a different declared app is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH), and without a declaration the host's app applies (C4); only without a host app does the declared app apply. On a gateway the host app of a route's requests is the route's metadata cosec-app-id, ahead of cosec.authorization.scope.app-id; a cosec-app-id that is not a string (a number, a boolean, a list or a map is not read as its text) or cannot be an app id (SCP-7) fails the request as an unmodelled error (500), never leaves it without a host app.
properties: model:ScopeResolverPropertyTest#the app and tenant follow the host and the credential
guards: gateway:PipelineGatewayFilterTest#two routes of different apps are each their own app
runtime:RouteAppTest#the route's app is the host app, ahead of the configured one
runtime:RouteAppTest#a route app that cannot be an app id fails the request closed, and says why
runtime:RouteAppTest#a route app that is not a string fails the request closed, and says to quote it

rules.statement: An anonymous request that declares CoSec-Space-Id is answered 401.
guards: runtime:PipelineTest#scopeRejectedForAnAnonymousPrincipal

rules.statement: When the values of one CoSec-* parameter differ, between the header and the query parameter or within either, the request cannot be read unambiguously and is answered 400. A blank value beside a non-blank one differs too; only values that are all blank read as not sent, and blank is ASCII whitespace only, so a value of Unicode spaces is a value.
guards: runtime:CoSecParametersTest#differentHeaderAndQueryValuesAreAmbiguous
runtime:PipelineTest#conflictingCoSecParameterIsInvalidRequest
spring-boot:WebAdapterParityTest#the three adapters answer byte for byte alike
runtime:CoSecParametersTest#aBlankValueBesideAValueIsAmbiguous

rules.statement: Only ScopeResolver constructs a Scope; no decoding path (JSON, header, cache) deserializes one.
guards: architecture:ScopeConstructionTest#onlyTheResolverConstructsScopes
architecture:ScopeConstructionTest#scopeIsNotADataClass

rules.statement: An unauthenticated subject is always in the default tenant (0) and has no roles, whatever memberships it is given.
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#an anonymous subject is in the default tenant and has no roles

rules.statement: A declared app that cannot be an app id (blank, *, containing ':' or a control character, or longer than 128 characters: the rule of a tenant id) is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH), with or without a host app. An app document's key (SnapshotKey.App) takes only such an id, so the control plane takes no app the data plane could never read: analyze refuses one with 400, and a candidate document with a binding in such an app, wherever it is, is a V2 finding (400) at the binding's app, so a document that holds one must remove it in its next change, and a change that only removes it is valid. The control plane skips such an app wherever it would build a key from a document (back-references, their repair, the checks, the grant analysis), and a stored record that names one (an open change of such an app, an instance status entry, an app list entry, a back-reference set's member) is skipped alone, never stopping maintenance or a write; the control API answers such a change 409.
The app is checked before the space: a request failing both is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH).
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#the app is checked before the space

rules.statement: A space id beginning with ( is reserved for CoSec: a declared one is Rejected(SPACE_NOT_MEMBER) whatever the principal claims, a document binding in one does not compile, and the control plane writes the default space as (default).
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#a reserved space is rejected even for a principal that claims roles in it
runtime:PolicyDocumentCompilerTest#the platform admin is bound only by the platform, and no binding names a reserved space
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#resources name one document each

rules.source: RFC 0004 §4.6 (round-1 review, 2026-10-26; RC1-15), split from SCP-7 by batch R4 (2026-11-08)
rules.statement: A declared app that cannot be an app id (blank, *, containing ':' or a control character, or longer than 128 characters: the rule of a tenant id) is Rejected(APP_MISMATCH), with or without a host app. An app document's key (SnapshotKey.App) takes only such an id, so the control plane takes no app the data plane could never read: analyze refuses one with 400, and a candidate document with a binding in such an app, wherever it is, is a V2 finding (400) at the binding's app. A stored record that names such an app (a change of one, or a head it was checked with; an instance status entry; a back-reference set's member; an app list entry; a head holding a binding in one) is a format error, and whatever reads it fails closed: nothing skips the record. Reading such a change is 503, a publish or a repair over such a head or set fails without moving the head, a maintenance pass stops without reclaiming, and the grant analysis takes every app as unknown.
guards: model:ScopeResolverTest#a declared app that cannot be an app id is rejected with or without a host app
